decisions.reason: The page-location objection is a false positive: library/braid-groups/garside-structure-normal-forms-and-the-center.md composes the definition, cancellativity lemma, Ore theorem and half-twist definition on one page. However, the final Remarks bullet incorrectly calls the small-n results about Delta vacuous and makes a blanket promise about everything on that page. For n=0,1 the alphabet is empty and the quotient monoid is a singleton; Delta is its identity, so assertions about Delta need not have an empty domain. Replaced only this remark by the precise small-n construction and a link to the half-twist definition. This is a nonfatal exposition/boundary overstatement, not a failure of the quotient construction or its universal property.

reviews.reason: Checked all five declared dependency definitions, the owning contract and composed page. Intersecting the nonempty family of congruences containing the Artin pairs gives the least congruence; compatibility makes [u][v]=[uv] independent of representatives. Associativity and identity descend from concatenation. Evaluation into any monoid satisfying the relations has a congruence kernel containing those pairs, hence factors uniquely through the quotient. Empty alphabets give exactly the empty word for n=0,1; n=2 has one generator and no relation pairs. No choice is required and no later cancellation or embedding theorem is assumed to construct the monoid. The repaired Remarks bullet correctly points to the half-twist definition and its Delta=1 convention. Definition text is byte-for-byte unchanged. This is the repair author's local check, not independent review of the repair.
